value.rationale: The source threat model expressly includes targeted misclassification, but its revised pairwise spectral witness is only untargeted in multiclass settings. The target-safe intersection restores a conservative class-specific upper certificate under the same known-readout measurement access, including exact handling of tie priority. It can therefore audit whether a specified target is certifiably reachable within a stated fidelity radius; the result is structurally useful even though the certificate may be vacuous or nonoptimal.
